text: Michael Cude, Project Manager, Operational Policy and Nazzareno Capano, Acting Director, Street Permits, Transportation Services will give a presentation on A Review of Accessible Parking Permit Exemptions. As per item IE27.16 , Transportation Services will present to TAAC with equitable solutions for issues associated with the current on-street parking exemptions offered to holders of provincial Accessible Parking Permits.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
